name: B10-0146/2024 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1828 renewing the authorisation for the placing on the market of feed containing, consisting of and of food and feed products produced from genetically modified maize MON 810 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council and repealing Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2017/1207
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to cancel its decision to renew the authorisation of genetically modified maize MON 810 for use in food and feed. Parliament argues the maize was approved despite concerns about its safety for people, animals and the environment, and despite the fact that a majority of Member States did not support the renewal. The resolution is an objection, not a change in the law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw the authorisation.
- **Who it affects:** The Commission, Member States, and companies importing this maize for food and feed.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to repeal its decision; Parliament's request is not binding.
